android.extraProguardRules:
# Keep the attributes Sentry needs to symbolicate a minified stack trace.
-keepattributes SourceFile,LineNumberTable
-keepattributes *Annotation*,Signature,InnerClasses,EnclosingMethod

# expo-modules-core resolves the headless app loader by Class.forName() on a name
# read from AndroidManifest <meta-data android:value=...> (AppLoaderProvider.kt:34).
# AGP auto-keeps manifest *components*, but not class names inside meta-data values,
# and expo-modules-core only -keepclassmembers its @DoNotStrip constructor, which does
# not retain the class itself. Without this, R8 strips it and expo-task-manager dies
# with ClassNotFoundException -- which takes ambulance background location with it.
-keep class * implements expo.modules.apploader.HeadlessAppLoader { *; }
